messages:
maria: heads up  console multi-flag apply blew a router pool this morning. saw queue_depth creep and auto-pause kicked in.

maria: ```
[2026-03-23T10:02:01Z] apply: id=INF-8602 user=tara scope=org:77 flags=210
[2026-03-23T10:02:02Z] orchestration: shards=24 tasks=960
[2026-03-23T10:02:03Z] router-eu: pool_capacity=500 queue_depth=470 workers=47
[2026-03-23T10:02:04Z] quota-svc: throttle=true auto_pause=triggered
```

maria: TL;DR  need a preflight estimator + small apply controls in the runtime schema.

devin: did preview estimator run?

maria: preview ran but sampling missed a shard with many routes. console-level parallelism had been set to 40 by an admin template.

ops-bot: incident created: router-pool-eu spike (incident-2026-03-23-003).

lee: design proposal: add apply_controls.max_parallelism (int), apply_controls.window_ms (int), apply_controls.backoff=[linear|exp|fixed]; add POST /v1/apply/estimate to return {estimated_peak, risk_level, suggested_parallelism}.

devin: runtime should enforce token-bucket per pool and emit telemetry: apply.estimate.risk, apply.fanout.inflight, apply.fanout.queue_depth. console should call estimator before real apply.

tara: UX note: show risk pill and an "auto-adjust" option that reduces parallelism to suggested value and optionally splits the apply into batches.

maria: ops policy: auto-pause when estimated_peak > 0.8 * pool_capacity, create paused state with resume instructions. allow admin override with audit trail.

lee: implementation plan: estimator will use cached router shard metrics + conservative hot-shard multiplier. provide estimator flag preview=true so dry-run surfaces risk.

devin: timeline: prototype estimator + metrics in 3 days, schema + console defaults in 6 days, UX copy from tara in 4 days.

maria: action items:
- devin: estimator prototype + basic telemetry (due 2026-03-26)
- lee: API schema + gating logic (due 2026-03-29)
- tara: console risk UX + auto-adjust flow (due 2026-03-27)
- maria: ops runbook update + incident link (due 2026-03-28)

lee: question  should enterprises get a locked-apply flow or policy-only? i vote policy-only (no new endpoint).

tara: policy-only fine; add explicit UI controls for org admins to lock override.

maria: linking INF-8602 and incident-2026-03-23-003. will follow up with perf traces once estimator prototype posts metrics.

devin: ack, posting prototype link here when ready.

maria: leaving thread open for updates. :eyes:
